implementation: interval.py integer enclosure arithmetic and exponential cache

review_findings.reason: Fraction conversion and arbitrary integer floor/ceil enclose rational inputs; addition/negation are exact grid operations. Multiplication scales four endpoint products by S; division scales all four endpoint ratios by S and rejects zero-containing denominator. Both negative and positive denominator intervals are handled.

The implementation computes exact Fraction partial sums S32 and S33 after halving the nonnegative input to [0,1]. Alternating remainder bounds hold, both endpoints are positive, outward conversion retains nonnegative endpoints, and interval multiplication encloses every squaring. Monotonic endpoint reversal for exp(-x) is correct, including zero, large exponents and dyadic underflow to lower endpoint zero.

A frozen dataclass integer endpoint pair is the complete key. The body depends only on that pair and fixed revision constants/arithmetic semantics. Results are frozen interval values; 128-entry LRU eviction affects cost only. Acceptance assumes ordinary application use without runtime monkeypatching or bypass of dataclass immutability; no persisted or approximate cache is admitted.

RC coefficient recurrence E_next=eE, u_next=I+e(u-I) gives v=E*v0+u*R by direct induction. Directional hysteresis has the same affine induction with B=H*h0, and beta uses the positive H*h voltage sign of current bounded-hysteresis model.c. The k=gamma/Q parameterization is explicit. SOC charge accumulation uses exact input Fractions and every advance, irrespective of voltage retention.

Each physical trajectory uses one stationary shape in the box throughout; interval dependence loss only enlarges enclosure. Strictly separated tau interval supports are more restrictive than positive ordering, not unsound. Exact input current/dt, fixed linear calibration and reference temperature, endpoint measurements, and absent aging/discrepancy remain essential premises.

Amin/Amax certainly give exact SOC extrema at observation endpoints. Continuous-time path extrema additionally use the constant-current-within-each-interval interpretation implicit in the stated Foster recurrence. State this explicitly if continuous path support is intended.

independent_checks.arithmetic_design: 200 signed rational interval pairs; each operation tested at endpoints and midpoint products; division only for zero-excluding denominators
independent_checks.response_design: 80 successive steps each for fixed shape and all 32 fixed corners of 1% shape box; dt cycles 0,1/35,0.1,1; current cycles 0,0.12,-0.17,0.25,-0.25; independently rearranged Decimal recurrence
independent_checks.interpretation: Supplementary finite controls, not mathematical proof or physical validation. Initial system-python attempt lacked scipy; rerun passed in existing experiment environment. test_quality.py was not yet present at review time.

remaining_limits: Conditional handwritten proof and implementation inspection, not machine-checked full-program verification.
No proof that physical batteries satisfy declared shape/calibration/current/voltage assumptions.
No calibrated population coverage, Gaussian coverage, aging or lifetime certification.
No guaranteed useful width or bounded desktop/target memory/time.
No generic independently known gamma claim: fixed k couples gamma to unknown Q.
Proof acceptance does not authorize C0 or H7 queries; those require their separately reviewed premises.
